title: Tidepool Sort
description:
# Tidepool Sort

Gather matching shells into the same tide pool. Tap a pool to lift its top shells, then tap another pool to drop them. Shells can land on an empty pool or on shells of the same kind, and each pool holds four.

30 tide pools grow from three kinds of shells to seven, and later pools leave only one spare pool. Earn up to three stars by sorting in few moves, with undo, hint and restart when you get stuck. Every kind of shell has its own shape, so colors are not required to play. The game plays fully offline and saves progress on this device.
gameplay: Move stacks of shells between tide pools until every pool holds a single kind.
features: Up to three stars per pool
